name: PlayHT
tagline: PlayHT is an AI text-to-speech platform offering over 900 voices across 142 languages with an emphasis on emotional realism and natural prosody. Its PlayDialog model produces conversational, human-sounding speech that outperforms many competitors on naturalness benchmarks. Podcast producers, audiobook creators, and app developers use PlayHT's API to generate and clone voices at scale.
